|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “You may 'react' to a system or sector by ▼an unpiloted Rebel starship and pilot of ability < 3 (together). OR ▲a device or non-lightsaber weapon.[Immune to Sense]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Panic (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Take a device or a non-lightsaber weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain at a system or sector, deploy (as a ‘react’) an unpiloted Rebel starfighter and a pilot of ability < 3 (simultaneously) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Sense.)” '''What changed:''' “You may 'react' to” → “Take a device or a non-lightsaber weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle or Force drain at”; “sector by ▼an” → “sector, deploy (as a ‘react’) an”; “starship” → “starfighter”; added “a”; “(together). OR ▲a device or non-lightsaber weapon.[Immune” → “(simultaneously) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune”; “Sense]” → “Sense.)”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 17. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Panic]].
* Later text: [[Panic (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Panic (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Panic]].
